prompt:
Hey, I'm a designer working on our SaaS product's component library and I need a proper machine-readable reference file for the border rounding styles of each UI component. We have a draft spec sheet at `design-system/docs/component_spec_draft.txt` that lists all the components and their intended corner styles (some described by shape name, some by raw pixel values, and one with a non-pixel unit). A few of the values in the spec are clearly wrong (e.g., a negative value and an absurdly large value) — please handle those gracefully and document any corrections.

For each component, I need both the standard CSS property value AND the equivalent Tailwind CSS utility class. Please generate this as a file called `border_radius_reference.json` where each key is the component name and each value contains the `css` and `tailwind` fields.

This will be used directly by our engineering team to implement the styles, so the values must be precisely correct.
